brief.prose: Ma offers an independent optional passenger journey to Stickney with the existing Nadia. It verifies the captain's real delivered passage after quest acceptance and settled fare, then records Ma's once-only personal relationship bonus. Ordinary passage negotiation and payment remain separate, existing bookings may qualify, and the shared traveller is never reset or summoned.

def.title: See her safely there
def.introduction: Nadia has been arranging a trip to Stickney. If your plans fit and she still needs a captain, see her safely there and tell me when you are back. Check her arrangements first; I am not promising her berth to anyone. Agree the fare with her as usual. If you have already booked her, you can still take this favor before you deliver her.

checkpoints.title: Bring Nadia to Stickney and settle the fare
checkpoints.instructions: Read +passage Nadia for her live arrangements. If you both want the trip, +passage/offer Nadia quotes a fare and prints the exact acceptance command; +passage/board Nadia invites her aboard. Read +ship/plan stickney and prepare your ship before sailing. Accept this favor before her arrival at Stickney; an existing booking can count. Complete her delivery and let the fare settle, then return to Ma in the Slack Line. Use +quest/check Yusra=tacsim.quests.safe_passage/quest.ma_safe_passage and +quest/finish Yusra=tacsim.quests.safe_passage/quest.ma_safe_passage. Your fare is paid through the ordinary passage agreement.

def.completion: The captain brought Nadia safely from Ceres to Stickney, settled their passage agreement, then returned to the Slack Line. I am glad to know she reached the Yard and that the captain followed through.
